post.description:
Verify the uploaded object and start parsing it (202 + job id, DOC-01-AC03/AC04).

Idempotent per upload: repeating it returns the same document and job. 409
`upload-incomplete` = nothing stored yet (finish the upload, then retry); 409
`upload-expired` = start over with a new intent; 422 `upload-mismatch` = the stored bytes
differ from the declared size/SHA-256 (the object is discarded).

delete.description:
Soft delete (editor+). The document then answers 404 everywhere and leaves the library;
the original stays in Storage until the retention cleanup (follow-up).

get.description: A short-lived signed URL of the original PDF for the viewer; ask again when it expires.
Current status of an async job (poll this, or stream `/jobs/{id}/events`).
Status transitions and progress of a job as Server-Sent Events.

200.description: Server-Sent Events: `event: job` with a `Job` JSON body on connect and on every change, `: keep-alive` comments, `event: gone` if access ends. The stream ends after a terminal status or after a few minutes (reconnect). Send the Bearer token in the Authorization header (use fetch streaming, not EventSource).

get.description: The authenticated user and their profile (created on first call).

post.description:
The user's own grade of a pending (essay / ungradable short answer) submission. Appends
a grade attempt referencing the pending one; the session becomes graded. Once.

Grade the answer on the server against the session's revision (option ids, never
positions); append the attempt; reveal answers and explanation. Once per session.

patch.description:
Edit a draft (e.g. enter the answer the source did not give), approve or reject it.
409 `stale-draft` when `base_version` is outdated, 409 `draft-published` once published.

get.description:
The run's drafts in source order, with validations, provenance pages and answer flags.
Drafts a failed job persisted are listed too (they are kept for the retry).

post.description:
Approve and register exactly these drafts as CONFIRMED questions (QIMPORT-01-AC03).
All or nothing: an id that is not a draft of this import is 404, a draft that cannot be
confirmed (e.g. an MCQ without an answer) is 422. Already published drafts return their
question (idempotent).

Run a failed (or cancelled) import again as a new job of the same run
(QIMPORT-01-AC04). The new job keeps the drafts the failed one persisted and adds only the
missing ones. 409 `import-not-retryable` unless the run failed or was cancelled.
